name: [✨🎉RELEASE] Dawn Piece
desc:
⭐ [Welcome to Dawn Piece] ⭐
PC supported & Mobile supported & Console supported

📌 This game is inspired by King Legacy , Blox Fruits , Verse Piece and the average One Piece game.

Level Max : 1500
Mastery Max : 500

Current Styles : Combat , One For All (Deku) , Muay Thai (Raz) , Breaker (Park Hyungseok) , Hellstep (Shinra)!
Current Abilities : Kilo , Invisible , Spin , Door , Rubber , Flame , Magma , Light , Wrath (Meliodas) , Aureus (Gilgamesh) , Hunger (Toriko) , Noctis (Madara)!
Current Weapons : Katana , Pipe , Shark Saw , Pole , Soul Solid , Bisento , Saber , Snow Blade , Night Blade , Ace , Fleur (Florentino) , Tenebrae (Minoru Kagenou) , Shadow Fangs (Sung Jinwoo) , Nox (Ulquiorra) , Lux (Grimmjow) , Voidedge (Free for Newbie) , Vampyruss (Alucard)!

-> Controls <-
Ctrl - Run
Q - Dash
Double Space - Sky Jump
E - Observation Haki
R - Flash Step
T - Armament Haki
Y - Race Ability
H - Special Ability

Join Community for codes and information about game!
